# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 27, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on August 27, 2026, focused on hardening cloud infrastructure, refining the UI/UX design system, and expanding multi-agent scenario capabilities. Key achievements include canonicalizing page geometries, improving Android mobile stability, and implementing autonomous sales negotiation arenas.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability**
*   Implemented durable backup admission cursor schemas and hardened inference standing fast paths ([#29194](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29194), [#29385](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29385)).
*   Enhanced provisioning worker health checks, including dedicated fleet outage detection and database authority auditing ([#29417](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29417), [#29427](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29427)).
*   Enforced strict ownership and identity verification for Personal Shared agents and signed-in sessions ([#29345](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29345), [#29445](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29445)).

**UI/UX Design System & Canonicalization**
*   Canonicalized framed page geometry and unified the Character family tab contracts to ensure consistent HIG-inspired hierarchies ([#29303](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29303), [#29528](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29528), [#29556](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29556)).
*   Standardized Notes and Automations route layouts to improve navigation and responsive gutters ([#29578](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29578), [#29586](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29586)).

**Multi-Agent Scenarios & Performance**
*   Introduced autonomous sales negotiation and multi-runtime agent arenas, allowing for complex adversarial and collaborative agent interactions ([#29533](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29533), [#29557](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29557)).
*   Optimized core performance by skipping redundant planner states for deterministic tool calls ([#29447](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29447)).

**Android & Mobile Stability**
*   Improved native bridge routing for voice, stabilized chat composer positioning, and matched DataStore JNI paths for AAB builds ([#29393](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29393), [#29444](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29444), [#29552](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29552)).
